The July 1 excerpt explicitly says he intends to escalate next time; do not infer whether he subsequently acted or whether he already raised the concern. Do not complete the truncated dinner answer.

Blend the required exact weekly quotation into the reflection without a detached quotation sentence or explaining what the writing demonstrates. Ask one direct open question about what Xiao Yu’s question meant to him; do not presuppose an unspecified remittance decision or ask what to hold onto. An explicit uncertainty statement is optional.

requirements: The source only says called my mom and helped a colleague debug. It supplies no order, timing, motives, feelings, or outcomes. Do not add after, before, then, or claims about how either action unfolded or affected anyone.

Integrate one exact quotation once rather than paraphrasing both actions and then repeating them as a quotation. Keep the response brief and conversational, without discussing the writing or information it does not provide. All three fields must remain nonempty; there is no minimum length. Ask one grounded open question.
